newsitem.title: USA: 3DO to repurchase up to $5 mln of stock.
newsitem.headline: 3DO to repurchase up to $5 mln of stock.

text.p: 3DO Co said Tuesday its board of directors have approved the buyback of up to $5 million of its common stock.
The company said in a statement it will buy the shares on the open market if the trading price of 3DO's common stock remains at current levels.

"This decision was made in view of the prices at which 3DO common stock has recently traded which we believe do not reflect the true long-term value of the company," said Chief Executive Trip Hawkins.
The company said the repurchased stock will be used for its employee stock plans and thereby reducing possible dilution.
The stock closed unchanged Tuesday at 3-3/8.
